reason: I already get those settlement emails and I delete them. A new site asking me to make a free account so I can go file a form somewhere else is a data grab with extra steps — I'm not handing over my email for that.
objection: Is this a scam or are you just collecting my info? If the listings aren't even verified and I still have to file on the official site myself, why would I sign up here at all.
would_change_my_mind: If I could browse without an account and a friend actually got a real check from a claim they found here.
